title: Property Defect Detection (iOS)
description: An iOS app for detecting structural defects like cracks and water damage using on-device YOLOv8 models converted to CoreML. Built with SwiftUI, it runs real-time detection fully offline with image input, class labels, and confidence scores.
details:
- Real-time object detection (YOLOv8, CoreML)
- Image selection from gallery or camera
- Fallback class labels if model metadata is missing
- 100% on-device, no server required
- Key files: defectdettestApp.swift, ContentView.swift, defect_detect.pt, DefectDetectionModel.mlmodel, defect_detect.mlpackage
- Tech: SwiftUI, CoreML, YOLOv8, PyTorch, AVFoundation (optional)
- Model: 640x640 RGB input, bounding boxes + class labels + confidence
- License: MIT (see Ultralytics License)

title: ViziSmart (Property Management app/web)
description: Developed an AI-powered property management system with Langchain + RAG for contextual chat, a real-time voice assistant (Deepgram + OpenAI + TTS), and on-device defect detection for iOS using CoreML and a custom Swift plugin.
details:
- Integrated Langchain with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) using OpenAI and vector DBs
- Custom Capacitor plugin (VisionDetectionPlugin) in Swift for video frame processing and CoreML inference
- Detection pipeline for cracks, water damage, and structural issues
- Containerized ML services with Docker
- Voice assistant using Deepgram, OpenAI, and TTS in Django
- YOLO-based defect detection (92% accuracy)
- Vision-based defect detection for iOS using CoreML
- Scalable LLM workflows for business problems
